name: TextOnPath
description: Repeating label that flows endlessly along an SVG wave, circle, or arc path via an animated textPath startOffset, with an optional dotted guide stroke and a text-to-accent gradient fill; repeats are fitted to the path length so the loop is seamless.
a11yNotes: The label is exposed once in a visually hidden span; the SVG with repeated copies is aria-hidden. Each instance uses useId for unique path and gradient ids. Under prefers-reduced-motion (or speed 0) the text is static. The loop pauses off-screen via IntersectionObserver and is cancelled on unmount.

propsApi.name: text
propsApi.description: Text that flows along the path (repeated to fill it).

propsApi.name: showPath
propsApi.description: Draw the dotted guide path underneath the text.

propsApi.name: gradient
propsApi.description: Fill the text with a gradient from the text color to the accent color.

propsApi.name: color
propsApi.description: Text color (defaults to the theme foreground).

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Accent color used for the gradient end.

propsApi.name: pathColor
propsApi.description: Guide path stroke color (defaults to the theme strong border).

propsApi.name: fontSize
propsApi.description: Font size in SVG user units.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the drawing in pixels.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element (CSS variables included).
